gse244832.allowed_use: Blocked pending terms. If resolved, training-only RNA and ATAC gene-activity populations may be integrated without false cell pairing; a held aliquot must be a frozen query and cannot participate in either training stage.
gse244832.model_access: No held rows in co-training, cross-modality loss, KNN pseudo-labels, feature intersection, head fitting, or calibration.

gse289173.allowed_use: Blocked pending terms. In principle, one-time RNA-only frozen-encoder cell-state mapping after selection lock; not RNA-to-ATAC translation.
gse289173.model_access: Anonymized RNA only through a new frozen query adapter.

gse296875.allowed_use: Blocked pending terms. If resolved, outer-training RNA and ATAC gene-activity populations may be used; same-nucleus pairing supplies no native paired objective and must not cross donor folds.
gse296875.model_access: Held donors excluded from both stages, KNN pseudo-labeling, feature construction, and checkpoint selection.

pairing_rules.gse244832: same_sample_different_aliquot represented as distinct unpaired populations
pairing_rules.gse296875: same_nucleus identity retained in metadata but not required or exploited by the model

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units; cells and KNN neighbours are not replicates.
rules.profile_rule: No scJoint output may be scored as an ATAC peak profile.
rules.query_isolation: Official co-training is prohibited for held donors; only a separately validated frozen encoder is admissible if terms resolve.
rules.terms_gate: No execution, adaptation, checkpoint load, or redistribution before written permission.
